title: Context Menu
summary: The Framework's action menu: data entries with icon, caption, value, shortcut, check, submenu, separator and heading, opened by openFor() into the top layer, anchored, with keyboard, typeahead and focus return. A host may still render its own items and own the lifecycle.

position.description: Deprecated: a menu has no tail since 1.3.0 (owner, 2026-10-12); the value is kept for its class and draws nothing.

tooltip.description: Deprecated: a menu has no tail since 1.3.0 (owner, 2026-10-12); the value is kept for its class and draws nothing.

entries.description: The menu as data (set as a property, or JSON in the attribute). See item_contract. When present, it replaces items and the content slot.

popup.description: Not drawn until opened through openFor(). A menu without it is drawn in place, as before.

search.description: {placeholder, empty, remote}: a search field above the rows (set as a property). Local by default; with remote: true the menu raises sf-context-menu-search {query} and shows the entries the host sets. A submenu entry passes it with `search`.

size.description: The menu's size: rows as tall as a field of that size (32px at 1/2, 40px at 1), its text, insets, search and footer. A submenu takes its parent's size.

width.description: How wide openFor() opens the menu: content (its longest line, between --sf-context-menu--min-inline-size and --sf-context-menu--max-inline-size), trigger (exactly the control that opened it; a long line ends in an ellipsis) or a CSS length. openFor(anchor, {width}) overrides it.

tabs.description: A panel with tabs: labels separated by |, or [{id, label}] as a property. The head (tabs and the close button) and the footer never scroll, the body does, and the panel keeps a fixed width (a ladder step, or width) whatever a tab holds.

active-tab.description: The chosen tab's id or index; the host renders that tab's rows into the content slot.

closable.description: A close button at the end of the panel's head.

fields.caption: string, a second line under the label
fields.value: string, read-only value at the row's end
fields.shortcut: string, shown at the row's end
fields.current: boolean, the place the person is
fields.keepOpen: boolean, a choice does not close the menu
fields.lang: string, the language the label is written in
fields.search: {placeholder, empty}, a field above the submenu that narrows its rows by label, caption and keywords
fields.keywords: string, extra words a search matches
fields.avatar: string, a picture URL drawn in the lead (a site's logo, a person)
fields.initials: string, drawn in the lead when there is no picture

fields.text: string, names the items under it

fields.caption: string or string[], the lines under it
fields.initials: string, drawn without a picture (from the name by default)

fields.options: [{id, text, icon, checked, disabled}], side by side; a choice is marked at once and the menu stays open unless keepOpen is false

focus.summary: Focus the current available item. A host that renders the menu itself waits for rendering and owns opening and dismissal.

openFor.summary: Open beside an element: top layer, anchored by SF.Position with flip and shift, focus on the first item (or 'last', or 'none'). The menu then owns its lifecycle: Escape, Tab, a press outside and a choice close it and return the focus -- to where it was, or to the anchor's own control when it was nowhere.

returns.description: Resolves once the menu is rendered and open: whether it opened.

toggleFor.summary: Close when already open for this anchor, otherwise openFor().

returns.description: Resolves to whether the menu is open afterwards.

close.summary: Close this menu and any submenu.

chooseTab.summary: Choose a tab by index and emit sf-context-menu-tab.

requestClose.summary: Close an owned menu; for a menu its host placed, emit sf-context-menu-close for the host to close it.

sf-context-menu-select.summary: An entry was chosen, at any depth. Cancel it to keep the menu open.

checked.description: The state a check or radio row asks for; null for a plain item.

group.description: The choice row's id when an option of it was chosen.

sf-context-menu-open.summary: Opened through openFor(). Bubbles and is composed; carries no detail.

sf-context-menu-close.summary: A menu opened through openFor() was closed. Bubbles and is composed; carries no detail.

sf-context-menu-search.summary: The query of a search the host answers (search.remote).

sf-context-menu-tab.summary: A tab of the panel was chosen; the host shows its rows.

accessibility.focus: Rows rendered from entries carry menuitem, menuitemcheckbox or menuitemradio with aria-checked, and aria-haspopup/aria-expanded for a submenu; one roving tab stop. Opened through openFor(): the anchor gets aria-haspopup=menu and aria-expanded; Escape closes one level and returns the focus to its row or the anchor; Tab closes the whole chain; a letter moves to the next item it starts. A host that renders the menu itself owns opening, Escape/Tab dismissal and focus return, as before. A header and a note are text. The options of a choice row are menuitemradio in a group, walked by the side arrows. A searchable menu opens on its field, which keeps the letters and the side arrows; ArrowDown goes on to the rows.

deprecations.replacement: openFor(anchor, {side, align}) places the menu; no tail is drawn
none: a menu has no tail

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-context-menu for every action menu: give it entries and open it with openFor(anchor). It opens below and start-aligned by default, with no tail, in the top layer, on the profile menu's surface. A profile menu is one: a header for the person, a choice row for the theme, a submenu with search for the language.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not hand-make a menu of divs and buttons: the row geometry, roles, keyboard and focus return are this component's
Do not ask for a tail: position and tooltip are deprecated and draw nothing
